perception_loop.assessment: Strong iterative perception loop. Ten apply_ops calls returned rendered board images: eight adjustment rounds at turns 0–7 followed by two explicit look-only reviews at turns 8–9. After the first rendered state, each subsequent edit was informed by the preceding render/diagnostics and itself produced another render, yielding seven clear render→adjust→render loops. The session was not a single-render session, although the two consecutive final looks contained no adjustment between them and therefore count as review rather than additional iteration.

economy.assessment: The committed result used 41 patch operations and completed in about 2.29 minutes, comfortably inside the 15-minute and 300-turn budgets. Work was generally proportionate for a detailed architecture diagram. There was one localized add-adjust-remove cycle: e17 was added at turn 4, rerouted at turns 5 and 6, then removed at turn 7. This is mild edge-routing thrash, but not a broad build-delete-rebuild cycle. The two final zero-op looks targeted different views and were used to investigate the remaining lint, so they are not repeated same-target NO-OP thrash.
